skill.summary: Group similar tasks to reduce cognitive switching costs and reclaim focus. Specific batch patterns aligned to your energy and context.

latestVersion.changelog:
Task Batching Blueprint 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a structured framework for batching similar tasks to minimize cognitive switching costs and improve focus.
- Provides detailed batch types (admin, communication, creative, decision, errand, learning, maintenance) matched to energy levels and time slots.
- Includes step-by-step workflow: understanding context-switching costs, identifying task types, mapping batches to your week, execution rules, and handling exceptions.
- Offers a sample output template for building personal batch schedules and inventory.
- Emphasizes practical advice over generic tips and adapts to various work/life contexts.
